mentions.name: Map creation and sharing tool (blueapex.pro)
mentions.description: This tool lets users create and share maps. Locals can publish maps with recommendations, and people exploring new cities can view those maps for suggestions.
mentions.audience: People exploring new cities who want to view maps created by locals for recommendations.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on a tool for creating and sharing maps.

https://blueapex.pro

I think it'd be useful for people exploring new cities to view maps created by locals for recommendations.
